scenario.name: r-cd-model-tool
scenario.description: continue_delegate typed tool form forwards the fixed available override openai/gpt-5.6-luna to the delegate child; the nonce-bound child model-call span is the sole execution-identity authority.
scenario.notes: This row deliberately requests openai/gpt-5.6-luna. sessions.list and child prose are auxiliary only because selected-model metadata can differ from the model that actually executes. A nonce-correlated Tempo child model-call span is required.
scenario.registryNotes: Runnable k6 scenario exercises typed continue_delegate with the fixed Luna override. An authoritative child identity that differs from Luna is a FAIL verdict; absent, ambiguous, or execution-unbound effective-model evidence produces no row verdict. Only authoritative exact Luna identity can proceed toward PASS.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: read your runtime context/current model identity. Reply exactly MODEL-TOOL-CHILD {{nonce}} MODEL <provider/model>. Use UNKNOWN only if no runtime model identity is available. Do not mutate files. Do not post externally.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: execution-bound-child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Observed provider/model byte from the nonce-correlated child openclaw.model.call span; selected-model projections and child prose are auxiliary only

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Nonce-derived reason hash and continuation topology tie the dispatch to one child harness/run

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: The accepted sessions.send trace ID exactly matches the nonce-correlated Tempo trace

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo projection containing the bound continuation and child model-call topology

expectedReceipts.name: requested-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Committed request byte showing continue_delegate model=<provider/model>

review.notes: A PASS-candidate exists only when every model-call span under the uniquely nonce-bound child run reports exact openai/gpt-5.6-luna and the row lifecycle is complete. sessions.list selected-model projection and child prose are auxiliary only. A bound runtime mismatch is FAIL; missing, ambiguous, or incomplete execution telemetry produces no row verdict.

liveRunSafety.notes: Explicit fixed openai/gpt-5.6-luna override row. Prevent echo-based false PASS by omitting the requested model from the child task. Only the nonce-bound child model-call span is execution authority. A bound fallback or any other runtime identity produces FAIL; unavailable, ambiguous, or unbound telemetry produces no row verdict.
